data.title: Duke Energy prepares for Isaias' rain and wind, encourages customers in SC Upstate and NC mountains to get ready
data.description: Duke Energy in Charlotte, N.C. is gearing up to address probable damage and power outages in the Carolinas following the aftermath of Hurricane Isaias. Even though projections indicate that Isaias is likely to track to the west of the Carolinas, concerns remain for the eastern part of the region. The company is setting up response plans to manage any potential impacts on power supply and infrastructure due to the hurricane.

data.title: ODL's Impact Rated Fiberglass Entry System with Keystone Frame Technology Earns 2026 Best of Products Editors' Pick
data.description: A renowned manufacturer of entry door solutions, ODL, Inc. based in Zeeland, Michigan, was recently honored with an Editors' Pick in the prestigious Architect's Newspaper's 2026 Best of Products Awards. The company received this accolade in the Openings – Doors category, showcasing its innovative system that integrates robust features to withstand severe weather conditions. The recognition highlights ODL, Inc.'s commitment to providing top-quality products in the industry.
